question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(vwh.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(vwh."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vwh
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vwh.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(vwh.whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(vwh.whsle_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
selling AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
      AND SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
loss_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(vlr."loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vlr
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vlr.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.year,
    w.category_name,
    w.avg_wholesale_price,
    w.max_wholesale_price,
    w.min_wholesale_price,
    w.wholesale_price_difference,
    w.total_wholesale_price,
    s.total_selling_price,
    lr.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price * lr.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price - w.total_wholesale_price - (w.total_wholesale_price * lr.avg_loss_rate / 100), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w
JOIN selling s ON w.year = s.year AND w.category_name = s.category_name
JOIN loss_rate lr ON w.category_name = lr.category_name
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name
